listing.summary: This mod allows you to build more buildings on a colony by adding a scroll bar to the "buildings" screen. You can build more than 12 buildings by installing this mod. The Mod uncaps the amount of structures you can add to a planet. It does not not change the industry limits.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a scrollbar to the colony building screen, allowing placement of more than 12 structures per planet.

description:
I'd like to thank Lukas04 for his implementation of the scroll bar.

Save Compatible

Manual Download
Requires LazyLib
Requires LunaLib

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Older versions and changelogs

Or support me on Ko-Fi

This mod allows you to build more buildings on a colony by adding a scroll bar to the "buildings" screen.
You can build more than 12 buildings by installing this mod. The Mod uncaps the amount of structures you can add to a planet. It does not not change the industry limits.

With the base settings, there is a 10% compounding upkeep penalty for every building above 12 - this can be adjusted or disabled, check the FAQ.

To install the mod, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

This is safe to add to ongoing games, and it will break saves if removed.

You will notice no change until you build your 12th building. Once you add the 13th, a scrollbar will appear.

The amount you can add is not limited, but exceeding the vanilla limits comes with a penalty. This can be toggled off in the settings.

FAQ
How does this work?
The mod adds a scrollbar to the industry screen. When you get to the last row, it'll be available to scroll down. Simple as!

What does "Cramped Infrastructure" do?
If you build more than 12 buildings in a colony, you will get an upkeep penalty. "Cramped Infrastructure" is the condition that tells you how much it is. Penalty applies to the total upkeep paid in the colony. This can be disabled or changed in the settings.

How does that penalty calculate?
Penalty ^ Amount of Buildings over the limit (example: penalty 10%, 5 buildings over the limit, 1.1^5 = 1.61, which is 61% more upkeep)

How do I disable the penalty?
Edit the setting in the LunLib setting menu in-game. Set the penalty setting to "false". Do note that I personally found the penalty feature rather interesting, since it makes you re-think your placements on high hazard planets.

Does this mod increase the industries I can build?
No. This mod increases the amount of buildings you can place on a colony (Default: 12 including Population & Infrastructure). It does not increase the industry slots a colony offers (by default: 4 on a size 6 colony), you can do that yourself in the settings.json offered by the main game.

Does this mod allow a colony to grow past size 6?
No. This mod increases the amount of buildings you can place on a colony, which is always 12 in vanilla, at any colony size.

discordPostHtml:
Additional building slots for colonies. Do I have to say more?

This mod adds a scrollbar to the industry screen, so you can have as many buildings on one planet as you want.

There is a 10% compounding upkeep penalty per building over the limit (can be disabled). Read the FAQ!

Changelog:
2.1.b - Updated for 0.98a, fixed the button
2.1.a - float fixed all the problems with the build queue.

2.0.f - Migrated all settings to LunaSettings, Scroll bar now only shows up when exceeding 12 buildings.
+ Save compatible +

aiDescription: Unlocks additional building slots on colonies by introducing a scrollable interface for the buildings menu. By default, placing more than 12 buildings incurs a compounding upkeep penalty known as Cramped Infrastructure, which can be adjusted or disabled in settings. The mod does not increase the number of industry slots available on a colony.
